DIAGNOSIS READY: Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (ADPKD) presenting with hematuria and right flank pain.

The IVP findings of multiple cysts in the medulla, combined with your history of recurrent UTIs and painless hematuria (microscopic bleeding between episodes), are highly specific for ADPKD, which predisposes patients to cyst hemorrhage and infection. Given the confirmed imaging and clinical picture, no further diagnostic testing is required to reach this conclusion.
